families.rationale: The title identifies only a generic investment-banking analyst job family and does not state a division or terminal task matching any admitted key.
The card does not name task coverage, capital-markets versus advisory scope, facing, depth, or exclusions among non-overlapping operational roles.
The generic words investment banking and analyst are not promoted into advisory, origination, research, trading, risk, or operations keys.
No mapping claim is made, so there is no promoted evidence-dependent binding to test by removing the public URL or task-family citation.
An outsider can reproduce the empty mapping from the generic card title and the absence of a stated division or task-family citation.

notes: Insufficient stated scope for a division-level or task-level binding; no mapping is promoted.
